---
toc: false
repo-actions: false
format:
  html:
    anchor-sections: false
    grid:
      sidebar-width: 0px
      body-width: 1250px
      margin-width: 200px
      gutter-width: 2em 
title-block-banner: none
listing:
  - id: testimonial-carousel
    template: home/testimonials-carousel-template.ejs
    contents: home/testimonials.yaml
  - id: news-card
    template: home/news-carousel-template.ejs
    contents: news/news
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: events-card
    template: home/events-carousel-template.ejs
    contents: events/events/*.qmd
    sort: "date desc"
include-in-header:
  - text: |
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
        <script src="assets/javascript/impact_counter.js" defer></script>
        <script>
        (function () {
          function equalizeCards(selector) {
            var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(selector));

            if (!cards.length) return;

            // Reset previous heights before measuring
            cards.forEach(function (card) {card.style.minHeight = '';});

            // Find tallest card
            var maxHeight = 0;

            cards.forEach(function (card) {
              maxHeight = Math.max(
                maxHeight,
                card.getBoundingClientRect().height
              );
            });

            // Apply tallest height to all cards
            var heightPx = Math.ceil(maxHeight) + 'px';

            cards.forEach(function (card) {
              card.style.minHeight = heightPx;
            });
          }

          //same as previous logic: when the media width is greater than or equal to 992 (lg breakpoint bootstrap)i.e. when two sections are side by side,  each cards' height should stay same in both sections. When the screen gets smaller and the cards are stacked vertically, equalize or make the height of cards within each section the same height.

          function runEqualization() {

            window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {

              var isSideBySide =
                window.matchMedia('(min-width: 992px)').matches;

              if (isSideBySide) {

                // News + Events together
                equalizeCards(
                  '#newsCard > .card-body > .news-card, ' +
                  '#eventsCard > .card-body > .events-card'
                );

              } else {

                // Equalize each section independently
                equalizeCards(
                  '#newsCard > .card-body > .news-card'
                );

                equalizeCards(
                  '#eventsCard > .card-body > .events-card'
                );
              }

            });
          }


          document.addEventListener(
            'DOMContentLoaded',runEqualization
          );

          window.addEventListener(
            'load', runEqualization
          );

          window.addEventListener(
            'resize',runEqualization
          );

        })();
        </script>
        <style>

        /*Remove gap between navbar and main content*/
        .quarto-title, 
        .quarto-header, 
        header {
            margin-bottom: 0 !important;
            padding-bottom: 0 !important;
        }
        main#quarto-document-content {
            margin-top: 0 !important;
            margin-bottom: 0 !important;
        }

        .page-rows-contents {
          grid-template-rows: [content-top] minmax(max-content, 1fr) [content-bottom] minmax(0, max-content) [page-bottom];
        }

        // font size adjustments


        /* Override Bootstrap's col-md-6 default 768px breakpoint —
          both columns stay full-width (stacked) until 1100px */
        @media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1099.98px) {
          .hero-row > .col-md-6 {
            flex: 0 0 100%;
            max-width: 100%;
          }
        }

        /* Re-apply the 50/50 split starting at custom 1100px breakpoint */
        @media (min-width: 1000px) {
          .hero-row > .col-md-6 {
            flex: 0 0 50%;
            max-width: 50%;
          }
        }

        .hero-row {
          align-items: center;
        }
        .hero-row .banner-image {
          width: 100%;
          height: clamp(220px, 28vw, 340px);
          object-fit: cover;
          object-position: center;
        }

        @media (max-width: 575.98px) {
          .hero-desc {
            padding-right: 0 !important;
            padding-left: 0 !important;
          }
          .explore-row > .col {
            padding-left: 0 !important;
            padding-right: 0 !important;
          }
          .events-news-row > .col-lg-6{
            padding-left: 0 !important;
            padding-right: 0 !important;
          }
        }

        .bg-brand-banner{
          background-color: var(--osc-accent);
        }

        .text-lmu-green {
          color: var(--osc-accent) !important;
        }

        .text-lmu-dark {
          color: var(--lmu-black) !important;
        }

        .text-lmu-acc-blue {
          color: #0F1987 !important;
        }
     
        .section-heading h2 {
         font-weight: bold;

        }
        .testimonial-carousel .carousel-indicators {
            margin-bottom: -1.8rem;
          }
        .testimonial-carousel .carousel-indicators [data-bs-target] {   
          height: 8px;
          width: 8px;
          border-radius: 50%;
          background-color: transparent;
          border: 1.5px solid #3f479f;
          opacity: 1;
        }

        .testimonial-carousel .carousel-indicators .active {
          background-color: #0F1987;
          border-color: #0F1987;
        }

        .quote-icon {
            opacity: 0.1;
        }

        .explore-card {
         transition: transform 0.25s ease;
        }

        .explore-card:hover {
          transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        /*Events and news card arrow*/
        .card-arrow {
          position: absolute;
          right: 1.25rem;
          top: 50%;
          font-size: 1.25rem;
          color: var(--osc-accent);
          transition: transform 0.25s ease;
          transform: translateX(0);
        }

        .news-card:hover .card-arrow,
        .events-card:hover .card-arrow{
          transform: translateX(6px);
        }

        .news-card .card-title,
        .events-card .card-title{
          color: var(--bs-dark-rgb);
          transition: color 0.25s ease;
        }
        .news-card:hover .card-title,
        .events-card:hover .card-title{
          color: var(--osc-accent);
          
        }
        .news-header-link,
        .events-header-link {
          position: relative;
          display: inline-block;
          color: var(--bs-dark-rgb);
          transition: transform 0.25s ease;
        }

        .news-header-link:hover,
        .events-header-link:hover {
          color: var(--osc-accent);
        }


        .news-header-link::after,
        .events-header-link::after {
          content: "";
          position: absolute;
          left: 0;
          bottom: -2px; 
          width: 100%;
          height: 1px;
          background-color: currentColor;
          transform: scaleX(0);
          transform-origin: left;
          transition: transform 0.25s ease;
        }

        .news-header-link:hover::after,
        .events-header-link:hover::after {
          transform: scaleX(1);
        }


        #listing-news-card.quarto-listing,#listing-events-card.quarto-listing {
          padding-top: 0;
          padding-bottom: 0;
        }
        
        .newsletter-button.btn-primary{
            transition: transform .15s ease;
        }
        .newsletter-button.btn-primary:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }



        </style>
---
